
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/23565240" title="发布于 2026-11-05 22:32">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript之LINQ扩展</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="Inwl1U-D">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，提供了LINQ脚本扩展功能。</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="5WV-qBIe"><code>IQueryable</code>扩展</li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="5WV-qBIe"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202611/417450-20261105221223478-1159822152.png" alt="image" width="1186" height="436" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="5WV-qBIe"><code>IEnumerable</code>扩展</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202611/417450-20261105221442313-1577565393.png" alt="image" width="1187" height="427" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>示例1：</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = list.WhereScript(x =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x % 2 == 0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结果：2,4,6,8,10</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="199Uk4E-"><strong>示例2：</strong></p>
<p data-pid="Em-k0YZV">动态脚本中注入变量和函数</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScriptContext();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> context.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">isOdd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, a =&gt; a % <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 被3整除并且是奇数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = list.WhereScript(x =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x % n == 0 &amp;&amp; isOdd(x)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结果：3,9</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="SKW0rerE"><strong>示例3：</strong></p>
<p data-pid="k1U_n_Ej">动态脚本使用Sql语言</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScriptContext();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 指定sql脚本语言</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> context.Lang =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SqlLang.Instance;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> context.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">isOdd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, a =&gt; a % <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 被3整除并且是奇数，SQL语法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = list.WhereScript(x =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x % n = 0 and isOdd(x)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结果：3,9</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="8K3by10v"><strong>应用场景</strong></p>
<p data-pid="9x1Ln1wu">前端动态添加查询条件，勾选查询字段、比较方式（等于、大于、小于）、填写数据，后端根据前端传的条件动态拼接查询字符串，但是查询使用ORM，此时AScript LINQ扩展就派上用场了。</p>
<p data-pid="9x1Ln1wu">大家项目中是如何处理LINQ查询中动态拼接查询条件的呢？</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="vOpq4y-_">nuget安装包：<code>install-package AScript</code></p>
<p data-pid="eAec5rsR">开源地址：</p>
<ul>

<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://github.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
</ul>
